mapper.select: SELECT /* getPopupContentDtl */ POPUP.POPU_SITU , POPUP.POPU_CODE , CASE WHEN #{englishYsno} = 'Y' THEN COALESCE(NULLIF(POPUP.ENGL_FIRS, ''), POPUP.CONT_FIRS) ELSE POPUP.CONT_FIRS END AS CONT_FIRS , CASE WHEN #{englishYsno} = 'Y' THEN COALESCE(NULLIF(POPUP.ENGL_SECO, ''), POPUP.CONT_SECO) ELSE POPUP.CONT_SECO END AS CONT_SECO , CASE WHEN #{englishYsno} = 'Y' THEN COALESCE(NULLIF(POPUP.ENGL_THIR, ''), POPUP.CONT_THIR) ELSE POPUP.CONT_THIR END AS CONT_THIR , CASE WHEN #{englishYsno} = 'Y' THEN COALESCE(NULLIF(POPUP.ENGL_FOUR, ''), POPUP.CONT_FOUR) ELSE POPUP.CONT_FOUR END AS CONT_FOUR FROM CT_POPUPX POPUP INNER JOIN TB_CODEXD SITU ON SITU.COMM_CODE = #{codePopuSitu} AND SITU.COMD_CODE = POPUP.POPU_SITU AND COALESCE(SITU.USEE_YSNO, #{commYes}) = #{commYes} WHERE POPUP.POPU_SITU = #{popuSitu} AND POPUP.POPU_CODE = #{popuCode}
